Its 7898 certificate steps each satisfy the remaining unique-coface and maximality free-face conditions and leave exactly the claimed subcomplex; the 30-vertex target is connected, every link is a single cycle and Euler characteristic is two. Scale-one free triangles and 15 scale-four antipodal pairs give the remaining filtration stages. The relative collapse (not Betti equality alone) certifies the degree-two persistence map.
